algorithmHints.auto: Nearest neighbour, 2-opt and Or-opt with kicks. Fast and almost always the best order.
algorithmHints.aco: An ant colony builds routes by pheromone. Noticeably slower on large farms.
algorithmHints.ga: Crossover and mutation of visiting orders, then 2-opt polishing.
